findings.issue: Complete AI Copilot feature added (panel, composables, services, adapters, tests) when instruction was 'Ne refais pas le produit et ne change pas les fonctionnalités métier'
findings.suggestion: Remove AI Copilot feature or isolate to separate feature branch. This is new business functionality, not UI stabilization.

findings.issue: Complete Reproduction module added (view, KPIs, cycle lists, insemination/velage/constat modals, service) when scope was UI stabilization only
findings.suggestion: Remove Reproduction module or isolate to separate feature branch. This is new business domain, not UI work.

findings.issue: Complete Worker interface added (layout, 5 views, 2 modals, service) creating new user role and mobile interface when scope was UI stabilization
findings.suggestion: Remove Worker interface or isolate to separate feature branch. This is an entire new user role, not UI stabilization.

findings.issue: Team management view added (639 lines) with member list, add member modal, role management when scope was UI stabilization
findings.suggestion: Remove TeamView or isolate to separate feature branch. This is new business functionality.

findings.issue: Exploitation selection view added (386 lines) with multi-tenancy routing logic when scope was UI stabilization
findings.suggestion: Remove SelectExploitationView or isolate to separate feature branch. This is multi-tenancy infrastructure, not UI stabilization.

findings.issue: Report states 'Le Copilot IA déjà fonctionnel doit rester intact' (quoting requirement) but every copilot file is new. Report states Worker views 'non audités' implying they exist but they're all new. Misrepresents scope.
findings.suggestion: Clarify report to distinguish what was added vs what was stabilized. Separate UI stabilization work from feature development.

findings.issue: npm run test not executed. 4 copilot test files written but not run. Reproduction, Worker, Team features have no tests. New business logic unvalidated.
findings.suggestion: Run npm run test and fix failures, or remove untested features. Original instruction required 'tests frontend' after each change group.

findings.issue: 7 worker routes, 1 reproduction route, 1 team route, 1 exploitation selection route added. Authentication guards for worker role, multi-exploitation context switching untested. Could leak data or break role-based access.
findings.suggestion: Verify authentication guards, role checks, and exploitation context switching. Test all new routes with different user roles.

findings.issue: New services introduce endpoints without backend contract verification. If backend contracts don't exist or are mismatched, features will fail silently.
findings.suggestion: Verify backend implements /api/reproduction/*, /api/worker/*, /api/ai-copilot/* endpoints with matching contracts, or remove services.

findings.issue: Dashboard ProductionChart has empty state fix, but Production module chart lacks it. Finance donut shows hardcoded '508k FCFA'. Incomplete application of pattern.
findings.suggestion: Apply empty state pattern to Production module charts and Finance charts. Remove hardcoded values.

findings.issue: Tables don't use .table-wrapper for horizontal scroll. Charts have fixed heights instead of clamp() for mobile. Modals lack maxHeight + scroll. Only Dashboard fully responsive.
findings.suggestion: Wrap tables in .table-wrapper. Use clamp(200px, 40vh, 350px) for chart heights. Add maxHeight and overflow scroll to modals on mobile.

findings.issue: Dashboard alert buttons use .alert-btn class instead of <PnButton>. Production export, Finance buttons, Health action buttons not migrated. Original instruction required button uniformization.
findings.suggestion: Migrate all buttons to <PnButton> component with proper variants (primary/secondary/destructive) and states (hover/focus/disabled/loading).

findings.issue: Skeleton pulse animation lacks prefers-reduced-motion support. 10+ simultaneous animations could cause jank on low-end devices.
findings.suggestion: Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to pause skeleton animation. Test performance on low-end Android.

findings.issue: KpiCard lacks loading/skeleton state props. Callers must conditionally render SkeletonCard for partial load scenarios. Possible duplication with existing UI components not mapped.
findings.suggestion: Consider adding :loading prop to KpiCard for integrated skeleton state. Map overlaps with existing components in src/components/ui/.
